title: ElevenLabs on AI Gateway
description: Vercel and ElevenLabs are partnering to bring 14 ElevenLabs models to AI Gateway . To celebrate the launch, all ElevenLabs models are 50% off on AI Gateway for the first 14 days, through November 9th. AI Gateway supports six different types of ElevenLabs audio models: Speech to text: Transcribe recordings or caption live audio as people speak. Streaming text to speech: Start playing audio while a language model is still writing its reply, so users don't have to wait for the full answer. Realtime voice agents: Let users talk to your app and listen to it respond out loud in a single live session. Useful for support lines, tutors, and in-app assistants. Music: Describe a track in plain text and get back a finished song or instrumental at the length you need. Sound effects: Generate game and interface sounds, or ambience that loops cleanly, from a short description. Multi-voice dialogue: Voice a whole conversation in one call, with a different voice for each speaker. All of these audio models are accessible through a single gateway API key. Your app or agent can transcribe what a user says, reason over it with your choice of hundreds of models, then answer in an ElevenLabs voice. You can also create soundtracks with generated music and sound effects. Every request lands in the same usage, cost, and trace views as your other AI Gateway traffic. Model types AI Gateway gives you access to 14 ElevenLabs models, spanning speech to text, realtime voice, and music. Speech and transcription Scribe v2 Realtime turns a user's speech into text while they are still talking. A language model of your choice then writes the answer. Eleven Flash v2.5 , a low-latency ElevenLabs voice model, reads that answer aloud as it streams in, so the user hears the reply begin before the model finishes writing it. Because each step is its own model, you can swap the transcription, language, or speech model without touching the rest of the pipeline. In the example below, a user asks whether they’ll make a connecting flight. The text model combines flight status and gate distance to answer, then the speech model delivers the response. Realtime voice agents Eleven Realtime v1 Max and Eleven Realtime v1 Mini run the whole spoken conversation in one model, which suits conversations where users expect natural back-and-forth, like a support call or an in-app assistant. Both models take the user's audio in and speak a reply back over a single WebSocket session, so there's no separate transcription or speech step to wire up. Eleven Realtime hears “Can I change the delivery address for my order?” and responds “I can help with that. What’s your order number?” over one WebSocket session. In the browser, connect with the useRealtime hook from @ai-sdk/react , which handles the WebSocket connection, microphone capture, and audio playback. In the hook's sessionConfig , set an ElevenLabs voice ID and turnDetection: { type: 'semantic-vad' } . These models support semantic voice activity detection (VAD) to decide when the user has finished speaking, but they don't support server-vad . The realtime guide walks through the full browser setup. Music and sound effects Music v2.5 and Music v2 compose original music from a text description. Name a genre, a mood, or the instruments you want, and the model returns a finished track at the length you ask for, with or without vocals. For more control, you can lay out a song section by section and give each section its own style and length. Sound Effects v2 works the same way for shorter sounds, such as footsteps, a door slamming, or rain that loops under a game level. All three models use generateSpeech , with text describing the sound you want instead of words to read aloud. This example requests a 30-second track: Multi-voice dialogue Eleven v4 , Eleven v4 Turbo , and Eleven v3 perform a script with several speakers in a single request. You assign a voice to each line, and each change of voice starts a new turn. A two-host podcast or a scene with a full cast comes back as one continuous recording, so there are no separate clips to stitch together. About AI Gateway AI Gateway provides a unified API for calling models, tracking usage and cost, and configuring retries, failover, and performance optimizations for higher-than-provider uptime. It includes built-in custom reporting , Zero Data Retention support , budgets for API keys , routing rules , and more. AI Gateway reflects provider pricing with no markup and doesn't charge a platform fee on inference, including on Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) requests. The AI Gateway audio docs have examples across the ElevenLabs models. Browse all audio models on AI Gateway, and try ElevenLabs at 50% off until November 9th. Read more

title: Deploy a container from a plain Dockerfile
description: You can now deploy a plain root Dockerfile or Containerfile on Vercel's Container runtime when no other framework is detected. Vercel selects the Container preset, builds that file, and routes all traffic to the resulting image. To get started with containers on Vercel, add a Dockerfile: When project detection matches another framework, such as Django, that framework still wins. To build use the Dockerfile or Containerfile instead, run vercel project update --framework container , or set the framework in vercel.json : A Dockerfile.vercel or Containerfile.vercel continues to win over a detected framework, and multi-service projects still use vercel.json services with a per-service entrypoint . The Container runtime is in beta, runs on Vercel Functions, and is billed with Active CPU pricing. Read the Container runtime documentation to get started. Read more

title: Vercel Agent sessions now cost 67% less
description: Vercel Agent sessions in the dashboard and Slack now cost 67% less on average. We rebuilt how Agent manages context, reducing the tokens needed per session and improving prompt-cache reuse. These improvements are live and require no action. What changed: Workflow-based CLI skills: Updated Vercel CLI skills give agents clearer guidance for common workflows and error recovery. Other agents using these skills also benefit. Incremental context management: Agent manages context more efficiently as conversations grow, including long Slack threads. Improved prompt caching: Agent preserves more reusable context across turns so more of it can be read from the cache. More efficient coding and planning: Updated guidance helps Agent plan changes and write code with fewer tokens. Vercel Agent’s billing rates are unchanged. Paid sessions are billed at the model provider’s inference rates plus a Vercel Agent fee of $0.25 per million tokens. View usage and costs in the Agent section of your dashboard. Read more
